transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. We have 120 returned servo drives to disposition for possible remanufacture today. Let's work through the standing checklist. Quality, please go ahead with your current findings on the returned drives.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My completed serial-number reconciliation found that exactly 96 of the 120 drives have complete service histories and are eligible for remanufacture; the other exactly 24 lack traceability and must remain quarantined. The reconciliation is still in the quality review queue and has not yet reached Elena's release packet.
